entities.name: Juma Mosque (Tbilisi)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Juma Mosque is the only surviving mosque in the historic Old Town, in Tbilisi, Georgia. Located at the foot of Narikala Fortress on Botanical Street, it is notable for its shared use by both Sunni and Shia Muslims.
